title: Interior access to shaftways.
officialText:
Door or window openings to a hoistway or shaftway from the interior of the building shall be
plainly marked with the word “SHAFTWAY” in red letters at least 6 inches (152 mm) high on a white background. Such warning
signs shall be placed so as to be readily discernible.
Exception: Markings shall not be required on shaftway openings that are readily discernible as openings onto a shaftway by the
construction or arrangement.
